```
(* ENGINEERING_CONTRACT
   CurrentTemperature and SetTempDisplay mirror inputs every scan; no retention.
   HeaterOutput: ON while temp<set (PUB003), OFF while temp>set (PUB004), equal holds previous actual (PUB002/PUB003 unspecified).
   Sensor fault (input<0 or >100) forces HeaterOutput OFF (PUB007).
   OverheatProtection: set when HeaterOutput continuously TRUE >5s via TON (PUB005); retained until 3s cooldown TON completes (PUB005).
   Override priority: fault and overheat protection force HeaterOutput OFF above normal compare (PUB005/PUB007).
   HeaterStatus mirrors final HeaterOutput; temperatures in degC; strict thresholds.
*)
(* CONTRACT_RULES [] *)

CurrentTemperature := TemperatureSensorInput;
SetTempDisplay := SetTemperature;

local_SensorFault := (TemperatureSensorInput < 0.0) OR (TemperatureSensorInput > 100.0);

tmp_CooldownTimer(IN := local_OverheatActive, PT := T#3S);
IF tmp_CooldownTimer.Q THEN
    local_OverheatActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF local_SensorFault THEN
    local_DesiredHeater := FALSE;
ELSIF local_OverheatActive THEN
    local_DesiredHeater := FALSE;
ELSE
    IF TemperatureSensorInput < SetTemperature THEN
        local_DesiredHeater := TRUE;
    ELSIF TemperatureSensorInput > SetTemperature THEN
        local_DesiredHeater := FALSE;
    ELSE
        local_DesiredHeater := local_HeaterState;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

HeaterOutput := local_DesiredHeater;

tmp_HeaterOnTimer(IN := HeaterOutput, PT := T#5S);
IF tmp_HeaterOnTimer.Q THEN
    local_OverheatActive := TRUE;
    HeaterOutput := FALSE;
END_IF;

HeaterStatus := HeaterOutput;
OverheatProtection := local_OverheatActive;

local_HeaterState := HeaterOutput;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```
